cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our bookshop failed here. Please label these boxes by subject, not 'leftovers'. We're taking the books to the right readers next time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then one box to start. Choose deliberately, please; this is how we learn what people actually want rather than renting another empty room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Short stories, then. Not the collected works; they need something before their bus arrives. Pack that box. We've finally found people with a reason to stop.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 corrects defeatist labels, A3 prescribes a smaller learning plan, and A5 selects stock as proof the failed shop redirects them to the right readers.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's money limit shrinks stock; B4's bus-stop offer causes A5's short-story choice.

relationship.evidence: B4 contributes a practical alternative, not just more bad news.

heightening.evidence: A5 finds a desired audience within B4's limited location and changes the packing accordingly.

specificity.evidence: A1 states a failed bookshop and packed books; B4 supplies a possible market stall.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's reason-to-stop phrase persuades B about the specific stall rather than naming an abstract lesson.
